findings.message: 5 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "The complete menu" (pill) above "All menu"; "Menu items" above "88"; "Categories" above "6"; "From" above "2,800 FCFA"; "Showing 88 items" above "Ice Cream"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 7 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "The complete menu", "✦", "Menu items", "Categories").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: 🍦 🎂 ✦ 🍨
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 2 gradient fill(s): div.hero-blob-a.absolute → radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(255, 220, 50, 0.12), rgba(255, 220, 50, 0.12) 35%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)) | div.hero-blob-b.absolute → radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(28, 79, 138, 0.5), rgba(28, 79, 138, 0.5) 35%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0))
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 103 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: a.inline-flex.items-center → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | figure.absolute.bottom-0 → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | figure.absolute.left-[4%] → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 6 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.mb-6.flex 1191px | header.mb-6.flex 1191px | header.mb-6.flex 1191px | header.mb-6.flex 1191px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 2 box(es) drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Prefer a filled surface or no box.

findings.message: 1 dashed/dotted border(s).
findings.fix: Remove unless it is a real drop zone.

findings.message: 3 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: Yellow-cream background (section #fbfaf5).
findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (4.5:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 1 text block(s) under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.

findings.message: 89 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The h1 is a bare name ("All menu") and nothing else on the first screen says what this is.
findings.fix: Keep the name if it leads, and give the line under it (18px or more) the plain words: what it is, for whom, where or when. In the study of 97 Sites of the Day, first screens that named nothing lost usability and content points.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Ice Cream" (screen 1, 50% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: With reduced motion requested, 60 text block(s) on the first screen stay invisible: "Flavors", "Ice cream by the scoop", "Browse signature creations and treats.", "Browse all flavors"
findings.fix: Put every hidden starting state inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference); the reduced page is the finished page (references/motion.md §8).
